operations.summary: Download a plugin licence for this installation (forwarded to the market)
operations.summary_zh: 为本安装下载插件许可（转发到插件市场）
operations.description: A live licence this installation holds is returned; a free plan issues the installation's free licence (repeat calls return the same one); otherwise the market answers 402 purchase_required. Naturally idempotent, so no Idempotency-Key is required. Market errors other than 401 and 5xx are passed through.

responses.description: Market error passed through (e.g. purchase_required, not_found)
Market error passed through (e.g. purchase_required, not_found)
The market has not mounted this entry (market_feature_unavailable)

operations.summary: What this controller holds of each market plugin (installed, enabled, withdrawn)
operations.summary_zh: 本主控持有的各市场插件状态（已安装、已启用、已下架）
operations.description: Installed means an installation head exists in any tenant; enabled that one is enabled; withdrawn that a materialized artifact (data pack, ui_page, provider) was withdrawn by the platform because the licence moved to another controller or ended; locally_disabled that the platform administrator stopped the plugin on this controller (POST .../disable). No query parameters are accepted.

responses.description: One item per plugin with local state

operations.summary: Stop a plugin on this controller for every tenant
operations.summary_zh: 在本主控停用插件：本机所有租户不再可用其功能，授权与计费不变
operations.description: Takes the plugin's feature code (module.*, pack.*, theme.*) out of the lease's grant on this controller: the module API, its workers, menus and publication treat it as not licensed (entitlement_feature_denied), and sites mounting a rule pack that needs it are republished without that pack. The licence, the lease, billing and the plugin's configuration are untouched. A plugin already stopped keeps its first stop (same answer). Installable plugins (themes, market rule packs, page plugins) are paused through their platform installation record instead. The feature code must be the one the market catalogue gives this plugin (looked up through the market relay before anything is written): any other code is 422 feature_code_mismatch, an unreachable catalogue 502.

params.name: Idempotency-Key
params.description: Per-user key: a retry with the same key and body returns the first answer; another body under the same key answers 409 idempotency_conflict.

fields.name: feature_code
fields.description: The stopped feature code; empty when the plugin was not stopped.

responses.description: Invalid request (idempotency_key_required, invalid_plugin_id, invalid_body; invalid: not a plugin feature code, or the code is stopped under another plugin)
Not a platform session with plugin_installations.platform.manage or platform.admin (forbidden)

The market catalogue does not give this plugin that feature code, or does not list it (feature_code_mismatch)
The market catalogue could not be read (market_unavailable); nothing was written

operations.summary: Enable a plugin stopped on this controller again
operations.summary_zh: 在本主控重新启用已停用的插件
operations.description: Lifts the local stop: the lease's grant applies again and sites mounting its rule packs are republished. A plugin that is not stopped answers its state (locally_disabled false) and nothing changes.
